summary: The apparent body-width outcome is reported as a specimen-level morphology estimand: each specimen contributes the median representative-plane width of its technical-valid nuclei, and specimens—not nuclei—drive between-group comparisons. Missing width values are omitted transparently with metric-specific specimen counts and dedicated availability summaries. Effect direction is manifest-defined, inference fails closed below three specimens per group, confidence intervals and effect sizes are reported when inference is available, and Benjamini-Hochberg correction is applied separately by test family. Retained representative evidence correctly reports descriptive results only because it contains one specimen per group, and its CSV, Excel, and PDF values pass the committed numeric contract.

findings.title: Representative report evidence is descriptive, not inferential
findings.impact: The retained two-specimen package validates reporting mechanics and cross-artifact consistency but cannot establish a WT-versus-KJ width effect.
evidence: audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/report/report_metadata.json:6-14 records one specimen per group and unavailable inference.
audits/validation/v571_6f9e73b_validation.md:104-105 explicitly disclaims a biological group effect.
findings.recommendation: Retain the current descriptive-only presentation. Generate inferential results only for a study with at least three independent specimens per group and interpret effect sizes and confidence intervals alongside FDR-adjusted results.

limitations: No full image stack or expensive inference was run, as requested.

The first combined pytest invocation could not initialize capture because the managed read-only environment offered no writable temporary directory. Focused tests that did not require temporary-file fixtures were rerun successfully with capture disabled.

The committed numeric-contract validator explicitly covers source CSV, Excel, and PDF values. PowerPoint and plotted point positions were assessed through their shared specimen-frame generation path rather than an independent pixel-level comparison.
The retained evidence contains only one specimen per group and therefore cannot validate empirical inferential performance on an adequately replicated biological study.
recommended_follow_up: For the first adequately replicated biological study, confirm metric-specific specimen counts after width missingness and review whether missing-width fractions differ materially by group.
Preserve the explicit manifest-derived reference/comparison roles and the separation between primary biological morphology outcomes and technical QC.
Continue reporting the legacy EDT width only as an explicitly labeled legacy field outside primary biological inference.
